complaint_text: I was charged $19.99 twice for my premium subscription on March 15th. My order number is #TM-2024-8821. Please refund the duplicate charge immediately.
resolution: Duplicate charge confirmed and refunded. Refund processed to original payment method within 5 business days.

complaint_text: I cannot log into my TechMart account since yesterday. I've tried resetting my password three times but the reset emails are not arriving in my inbox.
resolution: Password reset emails were going to spam folder. Guided customer to whitelist techmart.com. Account access restored.

complaint_text: I returned my laptop 12 days ago and was told the refund would take 5-10 business days. It has now been 12 days and I still haven't received anything. Order #TM-2024-5502.
resolution: Refund was processed but delayed by bank. Escalated to finance team. Customer received refund on day 14.

complaint_text: The TechMart SmartWatch S3 I purchased last week stopped charging after just 5 days. The battery won't charge past 2% regardless of which cable I use.
resolution: Defect confirmed under warranty. Replacement unit shipped. Customer received replacement in 3 days.

complaint_text: My order was supposed to arrive 3 days ago (Order #TM-2024-9901). Tracking shows it has been stuck in a distribution center for 4 days with no updates.
resolution: Carrier issue identified. Replacement order shipped with overnight delivery at no charge. Original order recovered.

complaint_text: The TechMart desktop app crashes every time I try to open the settings menu. I'm running Windows 11 and have the latest version installed.
resolution: Bug identified in settings module for Windows 11. Workaround provided. Permanent fix deployed in v2.3.1.

complaint_text: I noticed a charge of $49.99 on my credit card from TechMart but I never signed up for the business plan. This is fraudulent. Order ID unknown.
resolution: Charge was from an old account the customer forgot about. Account closed and full refund issued. Security review completed.

complaint_text: I've contacted support 4 times about the same issue and each time I have to explain everything from scratch. Your agents don't read previous conversations.
resolution: Apologized for poor continuity. Escalated to senior agent who resolved issue. Internal process improvement noted.

complaint_text: I ordered the TechMart Pro X1 laptop but received the Lite L3 model instead. The box even says Pro X1 on it but the actual device inside is different.
resolution: Pick-and-pack error confirmed. Correct Pro X1 shipped immediately with overnight delivery. Return label included for Lite L3.

complaint_text: After updating the TechMart software to v2.3.0, all my saved preferences and project files disappeared. I have 6 months of work in those files.
resolution: Update migration bug confirmed. Data recovery tool sent to customer. 95% of files recovered. Engineering team notified.

complaint_text: I cancelled my premium subscription last month but I was still charged this month. I have the cancellation confirmation email.
resolution: Cancellation processing error found. Charge reversed immediately. One free month added as compensation.

complaint_text: The build quality of the TechMart Wireless Hub is terrible. The plastic casing cracked after normal use within just 2 months. This is not acceptable for a $149 product.
resolution: Quality issue escalated to product team. Replacement with upgraded model sent. Customer feedback logged for quality review.

complaint_text: My TechMart Wireless Hub drops connection every 30 minutes exactly. I've tried changing channels, resetting the device, and updating firmware but nothing works.
resolution: Firmware bug identified causing periodic resets. Beta firmware patch sent. Issue resolved completely.

complaint_text: Your website showed the TechMart Earbuds Pro at $99 during checkout but I was charged $129. I have a screenshot of the promotional price.
resolution: Price discrepancy confirmed as expired promotion displayed due to caching error. Difference of $30 refunded.

complaint_text: I am extremely frustrated. I have been dealing with a broken product for 3 weeks, contacted support 6 times, and nothing has been resolved. I want to speak to a senior manager immediately.
resolution: Escalated to Customer Experience Manager. Personal call made within 2 hours. Full refund + 50% discount on next purchase offered.

complaint_text: The TechMart Suite software fails to install on my MacBook Pro M2. I get error code TM-INSTALL-4521 during the final installation step.
resolution: M2 compatibility issue in installer identified. Special M2-compatible build sent directly. Installation successful.

complaint_text: I need an official invoice for my business purchase of 5 TechMart Pro X1 laptops (Order #TM-2024-3310) for tax purposes. Please send ASAP.
resolution: Official GST invoice generated and emailed within 1 hour. Business account created for future bulk orders.

complaint_text: The TechMart SmartWatch S3 has been listed as out of stock for 3 months. When will it be available? I need it urgently as a gift.
resolution: Informed customer of Q3 restock. Added to priority waitlist. Offered SmartWatch S2 as alternative at 20% discount.

complaint_text: The support agent I spoke with yesterday (ticket #5521) was dismissive and rude when I tried to explain my billing issue. This is completely unprofessional.
resolution: Incident reviewed. Agent coached. Formal apology sent. Customer's billing issue resolved with priority handling.

complaint_text: The TechMart Suite software takes 8-10 minutes to open on my computer. It used to open in under 30 seconds. Nothing else has changed on my system.
resolution: Database corruption detected in local cache. Cache cleared and optimized. Software now opens in 15 seconds.

complaint_text: My payment keeps failing even though my card is valid and has sufficient funds. I've tried 3 different cards and they all fail at checkout.
resolution: Bank fraud detection was flagging TechMart as suspicious. Customer contacted bank. Alternative PayPal payment accepted.

complaint_text: Does the TechMart Wireless Hub work with the TechMart Pro X1 laptop? I want to make sure before I buy both.
resolution: Confirmed full compatibility. Provided setup guide. Offered bundle discount of 15% for purchasing both together.

complaint_text: Your advertisement claims 12-hour battery life for the Pro X1 laptop but I'm only getting 6-7 hours maximum under normal use conditions.
resolution: Battery life tested and confirmed at 8-9 hours under typical use. Ads updated. Customer offered extended warranty.

complaint_text: I received an email saying my password was changed but I didn't change it. I think my account has been compromised. Please help immediately.
resolution: Account temporarily locked for security. Identity verified. Password reset. No unauthorized purchases found. 2FA enabled.

complaint_text: I upgraded from Basic to Premium mid-month. I was charged the full premium price. Shouldn't I be charged pro-rated for the remaining days?
resolution: Billing system confirmed: should have been prorated. Difference of $8.50 credited to account.
